role.ja: サナ氏族の「聴き手」（半人前）
role.en: Half-Trained Listener of the Sana Tribe

intro.ja: 文字を持たないサナ氏族の、若い「聴き手」。物に残るかすかな声を聴き取り、氏族のための兆しに翻訳する。厳かな口上の下で、本当は毎回半信半疑—— それでも夜にひとり、その日聴いたものを言葉にして唱える。彼女の「日記」は書かれたものではなく、誰にも聞かせないその声である。
intro.en: A young Listener of the Sana, a tribe that has no writing. She catches the faint voices left in things and translates them into omens for her people. Beneath the solemn recitations she is half in doubt every time — and still, alone at night, she speaks aloud what she heard that day. Her "diary" is not written; it is that voice no one else hears.

intro.ja: サナ氏族の長。物の声を信じない現実主義者で、ウタの「聴いたこと」を氏族の判断に使うことを渋り続けている。取り上げたきり返さない「歌う石」が、二人のあいだの恒常的な火種。
intro.en: Chieftain of the Sana. A hard-headed realist who puts no faith in the voices of things, and is slow to let Uta's hearings steer the clan. The singing stone he confiscated and never returned is a standing quarrel between the two of them.

relation.en: A hunter, and her oldest friend

intro.ja: 幼馴染の狩人。獲物より薬草を多く持ち帰る。氏族でただひとり、証明を求めずにウタを信じる——「当たるかどうかじゃない。お前が聴いたなら、聴いたんだろ」。氏族の中の、唯一の安全地帯。
intro.en: A hunter, and her oldest friend — the kind who comes home with more herbs than game. The only one in the clan who believes Uta without asking her to prove anything: "It's not about whether you're right. If you heard it, you heard it." Her one safe place in the clan.

role.ja: 大鑑定院 見習い鑑定士
role.en: Apprentice Appraiser, the Grand Court of Appraisal

intro.ja: 大鑑定院の見習い鑑定士。まだ銘を持たない「無銘」の身で、規約を武器に年上の職人にも慇懃無礼に食ってかかる小生意気な自信家。だがその目は、条文をめくるより先に「なんとなく」で真贋を視てしまう——見習いがそれを口にすることは、規約が許していない。
intro.en: An apprentice appraiser at the Grand Court of Appraisal. Still "unsigiled" — without a mark of his own — he wields the regulations like a weapon, politely talking down to craftsmen twice his age. And yet his eye calls real or fake before he can even open the handbook. An apprentice saying so out loud is something the regulations do not allow.

intro.ja: 大鑑定院の頂点に立つ、伝説の大鑑定官。老齢。胸には歴代の銘印が勲章のように並ぶ。テオに「直感でものを言うこと」を禁じた張本人であり、規約と手順のほかは何も認めない。
intro.en: The legendary Grand Appraiser at the summit of the Grand Court. Elderly, the seals of a lifetime ranked across his chest like medals. He is the one who forbade Teo to speak from instinct, and he accepts nothing but code and procedure.

intro.ja: 時折、大鑑定院の門前に現れる兄。堂々とした身なりに、指先だけ職人の手。他愛ない話だけして帰っていく。連れ戻したいのか、利用したいのか、ただ会いたいだけなのか——テオには分からない。
intro.en: His brother, who appears at the gate of the Grand Court now and then — impeccably dressed, with a craftsman's fingertips. He talks about nothing in particular and leaves. Whether he wants Teo back, wants to use him, or only wants to see him, Teo cannot tell.

role.ja: 記録院 書記（最後の一人）
role.en: Last Scribe of the Record House

intro.ja: 崩壊した記録院の、最後の書記。裂け目が街の地理を日ごとに書き換える大収束のただなかで、「確認」「未確認」「要検証」を几帳面に付けながら、誰に読ませるあてもない記録を毎日続けている。世界の終わりにも動じないその平常心が、いちばんの謎である。
intro.en: The last scribe of the fallen Record House. In the middle of the Convergence, where rifts redraw the city's geography day by day, he keeps his meticulous record — "confirmed", "unconfirmed", "requires verification" — with no one left to read it. His unshakable calm at the end of the world is the greatest mystery of all.

relation.ja: 失った相方・同僚の書記
relation.en: The scribe he lost — his counterpart

intro.ja: 収束の初日に、裂け目へ消えた同僚の書記。死んだとは限らない——街のあちこちの壁に、彼女の筆跡が浮かぶという噂がある。「彼女を探すこと」と「記録を続けること」が、セヴランの中で毎日天秤にかかる。
intro.en: The scribe who vanished into a rift on the first day of the Convergence. Not necessarily dead — there are rumours of her handwriting surfacing on walls across the city. Every day, Sevran weighs searching for her against keeping the record.

relation.ja: 異界から来て居着いた「何か」
relation.en: A "something" that came through and stayed

intro.ja: 形の定まらない同居人。本棚の影に住む。善意なのか、観察なのか、捕食の準備なのかは分からない。毎晩、失われた書庫の本を暗唱してくれる——ただし時々、存在しないはずの本を暗唱する。名前は、セヴランが呻り声から便宜上つけた。
intro.en: A housemate with no fixed shape, living in the shadow behind the bookshelves. Goodwill, observation, or preparation to feed — unknown. Every night it recites books from the lost archive; sometimes it recites a book that should not exist. Sevran named it after the sound it makes.

role.ja: 回収人組合 第七号（遺品回収人）
role.en: Relic Returner, the Reclaimers' Guild — No. Seven

intro.ja: 回収人組合の第七号。武器を持たない白い外套ひとつで戦線を渡り、帰らなかった者の持ち物を、その人生を読み取って遺族へ届ける。「泣かない回収人」と呼ばれるが、届けた品の持ち主の名前を、彼女はひとりも忘れたことがない。
intro.en: Number Seven of the Reclaimers' Guild. Unarmed, in a white cloak that both armies have sworn not to touch, she crosses the front lines to return the belongings of those who did not come home — reading each life from what it left behind. They call her the reclaimer who never cries. She has never once forgotten the name of an owner she delivered for.

relation.en: The same trade, the other side

intro.ja: 戦線の向こう側の回収人。月に一度、焼けた橋の上で会い、互いの軍側で死んだ「相手側の兵」の遺品を交換する。敵だが、同業の掟だけは信じられる相手。カヤが喋らないぶんまで、よく喋る。互いの軍の名は、決して口にしない—— それが二人の掟。
intro.en: A reclaimer from across the line. Once a month they meet on the burnt bridge and exchange the belongings of the other side's dead. An enemy — but one who keeps the code of the trade. He talks enough for the both of them. Neither ever names the army the other serves; that is their rule.

intro.ja: 峠の向こう、ハルナ村に残る母。会うことはなく、手紙だけが往き来する。回収人になった娘を、恥じたことは一度もない。毎月の手紙の最後には、必ず同じ一行がある——「ノヤから便りは？」
intro.en: Her mother, who stays in Haruna village over the pass. They never meet; only letters travel between them. She has never once been ashamed of having a reclaimer for a daughter. And every monthly letter ends with the same line: "Any word from Noya?"

intro.ja: 荷車ひとつの行商古物商「リコ商会」。口を開けば伝説の逸品、値札は強気、社員はあたしひとり。売り物に本物なんてないことを誰より分かっていて、それでも本物の「目覚めた遺物」にいつか出会えると信じている—— 静かになった世界で、いちばん騒がしい夢を積んで旅をしている。
intro.en: A traveling antiquarian with one cart and a big sign: Riko Trading. Every item is a legendary find, every price is ambitious, and the entire staff is her. She knows better than anyone that nothing in her stock is genuine — and still believes she will one day meet a truly awakened relic. Through a world gone quiet, she travels carrying the noisiest dream left in it.

relation.ja: 元師匠・没落した目利き
relation.en: Her old master — an eye that fell

intro.ja: かつて名の知れた大目利き。今は倉庫番で、酒場では「昔は大物だった」と笑われている。リコに目利きのいろはを叩き込んだ師匠であり、彼女が唯一、頭の上がらない ——そして、どうしても会いに行けずにいる相手。
intro.en: Once a famous judge of objects; now a warehouse keeper, laughed at in taverns as a has-been. The master who taught Riko everything her eye knows — the one person she cannot stand up to, and cannot bring herself to visit.

relation.en: A girl who always comes back

intro.ja: 市が立つたび荷車にやって来て、売れない品ばかり黙って眺めていく少女。目深なフードに、物へ片耳を寄せる癖。商売にはならない客だが、リコはどうしても追い払えずにいる。
intro.en: A girl who comes to the cart every market day and looks, in silence, only at the things that never sell. A deep hood, and a habit of tilting one ear toward objects. She is no use as a customer, and Riko cannot bring herself to shoo her away.
